description: This file defines a custom PHP class 'ADODB_mysqlt' extending 'ADODB_mysql' with MySQL transaction support and related classes for recordset handling, tailored for MySQL transaction management in the ADODB database abstraction layer.

classes.name: ADODB_mysqlt
classes.description: A specialized class extending ADODB_mysql implementing transaction control methods such as SetTransactionMode, BeginTrans, CommitTrans, RollbackTrans, and RowLock for MySQL.

methods.name: SetTransactionMode
methods.description: Sets the transaction isolation level for the session.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Starts a new transaction, disabling autocommit.

methods.name: CommitTrans
methods.description: Commits the current transaction, optionally rolling back if 'ok' is false.

methods.name: RowLock
methods.description: Locks specific rows in a table for update.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_mysqlt
classes.description: A recordset class extending ADORecordSet_mysql with specific fetch modes for MySQL transaction recordsets.

methods.name: MoveNext
methods.description: Advances to the next row in the recordset, fetching data via mysql_fetch_array.
